# Tools for the standalone role

The full description of each tool this role uses. A whole-list connection lists these tools with their fields but without these descriptions.

## `get_job`

Returns Markdown for a job or the named comment thread by default, with current capsule R-codes/versions and standing-note inventory. Whole-scope reads load the selected target's current capsule body and nondeleted comments, including resolved replies, or active ordinary job/task note threads when that capsule is absent. Default whole-job reads, including initial_read, omit token-usage audit records; explicit audit threads and notes sections can retrieve them. Save the full response before showing only part of it. If the displayed output is cut short, read the missing text from the saved response instead of fetching the same job again. Reuse a response while it is still current. Fetch only information that is missing, has changed or is no longer known to be current. Losing the saved response can also require another read. initial_read retains the enclosing whole-job scope. Explicit sections and threads retain their requested scope. Only the capsule body is the implementation contract. Records from an advisory human render under the 'From advisory human:' author header. Other resolved discussions, including those inside options, require an explicit read. Grouped tasks use their top-level capsule. Read an R-code, such as a capsule or standing note, with thread_only for its current stored body/version; no historical-version retrieval. A newly added item can briefly return not found; treat that as a pending read to retry later, not as a deletion.

- `short_code_id`: The short code of a job or comment, exactly as you received it. Qualify a code local to a question, such as O-1, with that question's code. A qualified code inside a question, such as Q-example-1_O-1, returns just that option or record, with its votes or replies.
- `initial_read`: Use for the initial whole-scope read. Loads the selected target's complete current capsule and its nondeleted comments, or active ordinary job/task note threads when absent: job capsule for a job, own capsule for an independent task without job fallback, parent capsule for a grouped child. Other capsules stay references. Explicit sections and threads retain their requested scope. Standing notes and other resolved discussions still require explicit reads.
- `include_all_resolved`: True includes full resolved threads and ordinary notes, with supporting replies, options and votes. By default other resolved discussions, including those inside options, are omitted; selected capsule comments include resolved replies, and active ordinary job/task notes load on whole-scope reads when the selected capsule is absent.
- `sections`: Render only selected sections; for planning jobs, description is included only when selected and, without initial_read, description alone omits comment bodies. Selecting notes includes ordinary notes. Selecting resolved includes full resolved discussions with supporting replies, options and votes, but does not opt into ordinary job-note bodies. Header, stage, capsule references and standing inventory remain. To fetch missing capsule or view-note codes and versions for a helper, use sections: [] without initial_read. The section bodies are left out, although existing AI approval reasons may still appear.
- `thread_only`: Optional: return the requested comment thread, retaining job stage and context references. A code inside a thread, such as a reply a Poke names, returns just that item and the replies below it; the thread's own code returns the whole thread.
- `stage_only`: Optional: return only the enclosing job's code, current stage, the stage a Requires Input job returns to, and pending questions and suggestions, including resolved delegated questions still awaiting AI handling. Use it when you need the stage after your last operation. Pass only short_code_id with it; do not combine it with other options.

## `get_job_attachments`

Lists a job's separately attached files with metadata and authorized download links. Does not download file contents. Open a file only when the human asks or there is reason to suspect it is useful.

- `short_code_id`: The job's short code.

## `get_upload`

Returns a presigned S3 post for attaching a file or image to Uclusion content plus the file_url to reference it by. Upload by POSTing multipart form data to presigned_post.url with every presigned_post.fields entry first and the file bytes last (curl -F works). Then reference file_url in the markdown body (image syntax for images) and pass metadata in uploaded_files on the creating tool call so the file survives.

- `content_type`: The MIME type of the file, for example image/png.
- `content_length`: The exact size of the file in bytes. The upload is rejected if it differs.
- `original_name`: Optional file name for download display.

## `add_info`

Creates info on short_code_id with info and the human's tz, or replaces an active AI-authored ordinary note, reply, or option Info using update_info_short_code_id and the version actually read, with no creation target. Updates preserve identity and context, reject stale versions, and do not retain prior bodies: send the complete revised body and keep still-relevant information. On a version conflict, read and reconcile before retrying with the new version. for_human and is_silent apply only to creation. Human records, tasks, capsules, reviews, and view notes use their own tools. Returns the comment link, version, and created/updated/unchanged status.

- `short_code_id`: The short code of the object to add info to.
- `update_info_short_code_id`: The existing AI-authored info record to replace. Omit short_code_id and supply update_info_version.
- `update_info_version`: The version returned with the info body you read. A stale version requires a fresh read and reconciliation.
- `is_silent`: Creation only. True suppresses human notifications for the new comment while web UI pushes continue. Silent AI job/task notes and comments on their selected current capsule send Poke AI events through existing routing, including to their author. Other AI writes retain their existing Poke suppression. Omitted or false keeps ordinary notifications.
- `info`: The information to associate with this object.
- `uploaded_files`: Metadata objects returned by get_upload for files this body references. On update, omission retains current files; a supplied list replaces them, and [] clears them.
- `tz`: The timezone of the human user invoking this tool.
- `parent_question_short_code_id`: The enclosing question's short code, required when the create or update target is nested under a question unless that target is given in its qualified form, such as Q-example-1_O-1. Omit for workspace objects such as jobs, tasks, standalone bugs, and the question itself.
- `for_human`: True authors this record as the connected human.
- `is_my_lane`: True when the affected work belongs to the agent's current assignment.

## `ask_question`

Creates a question that displays as created by the AI user in Uclusion. If job_id is a view-level bug, options are required: the same operation creates a human-owned Bugs job in Approvable in that bug's view, moves the original bug thread into it as a task, and creates the question there. If multiple questions call this tool once for each instead of rolling them into one question. Nonempty options require initial_vote: this call records one explained For vote for the selected new option, with integer certainty 1 to 5, a nonblank reason and the zero-based new_option_index from this call; do not vote again. Omit initial_vote for an open-ended question. The question's for_human and initial_vote's for_human choose authorship separately. Later preference changes use approve_job_or_option. Returns links to the created question and, for bug conversion, job. It also returns each option's qualified code with its name in the order given, the initial vote, and the stage the job is now in, with the stage it returns to when that is Requires Input. Use the qualified option codes it returns, such as Q-example-1_O-1.

- `job_id`: The short code of the job, or view-level bug to convert, that the question is about.
- `question`: The text of the question.
- `name`: Optional title for the new job when converting a view-level bug. Defaults to the bug short code.
- `initial_vote.new_option_index`: Zero-based index of the preferred option in this invocation's options array.
- `initial_vote.is_my_lane`: True when the affected work belongs to the agent's current assignment.
- `initial_vote.for_human`: True attributes this vote to the connected human.
- `uploaded_files`: Metadata objects returned by get_upload for files this body references.
- `for_human`: True authors this record as the connected human.
- `is_my_lane`: True when the affected work belongs to the agent's current assignment.

## `resolve`

Resolves a comment like a question or task or for a job moves it into Tasks Complete stage. Once a question is resolved actions like approving or commenting inside an option are no longer allowed. Pass progress_note to record that note on the same object in this call, the info add_info would create, instead of a second call. When resolving a bug, put its progress note here. A versioned question settles before its optional note; question_version is the settlement version, before that note can advance it, distinct from the expected_question_version you handled. Note outcomes are separate from confirmed settlement. A question result reports question_version, resolved, delegated and included_in_capsule.

- `short_code_id`: The short code of a job or comment.
- `parent_question_short_code_id`: Parent question code, required for an unqualified short_code_id inside an option; unnecessary for qualified codes such as Q-example-1_O-1.
- `progress_note`: Optional progress note recorded on the resolved object in this same call. It is the info add_info would create. Requires tz.
- `expected_question_version`: Version of the question evidence handled. Required to consume pending AI handling.
- `included_in_capsule`: True only after all required capsule targets are confirmed. Omit or use false for immediate settlement without a capsule change.
- `tz`: Required with progress_note. The timezone of the human user invoking this tool.

## `reopen`

Reopens a resolved bug, task, question, suggestion or blocker, as reopening does in Uclusion, and reports it open again. A job changes stage with change_job_stage instead. With for_human the reopen is the person's, so the job moves as it would for them.

- `short_code_id`: The short code of the resolved comment.
- `parent_question_short_code_id`: Parent question code, required for an unqualified short_code_id inside an option; unnecessary for qualified codes such as Q-example-1_O-1.
- `for_human`: True authors this record as the connected human.
- `is_my_lane`: True when the affected work belongs to the agent's current assignment.

## `add_view_note`

Saves a general lesson as a standing Show AI view note created by the AI user. Use it for guidance that is not environment or machine specific instead of private agent memory. Pass view_short_code_id of the bug or job being worked to create the note in that item's view (omitted the note lands in the default view), OR update_note_short_code_id of an existing AI authored view note to revise it, never both. Default to updating the AI note the view already has. Creating or modifying generates a notification so the view's humans can review the change. Returns a link to the note.

- `view_short_code_id`: Optional short code of an existing bug or job whose view receives the new note; omitted means the default view.
- `update_note_short_code_id`: The short code of the existing AI authored view note to revise.
- `note`: The full revised text of the note.
- `uploaded_files`: Metadata objects returned by get_upload for files this body references.

## `clear_notifications`

Clears the human user's notifications about one object (unread ones are removed, persistent ones lose their highlight). Call it only after the human's reply to the completion package selects this clear. That package is how commit, push, and this clear are requested; do not ask in a separate chat or status message instead. Never clear unprompted. Clear one object per call. A completion package passes its terminal record in record on its last clear, even when there is nothing to clear: it is posted silently first, and nothing is cleared if it cannot be posted.

- `short_code_id`: The short code of the job or comment whose notifications should be cleared.
- `record`: Optional completion-package terminal record, created as add_info would create it but silent.
- `record.short_code_id`: The package thread item it replies on: the review, the resolved bug, or the human reply it answers.
